name: MagicLab
summary: MagicLab (Magiclab Robotics Technology) is a Chinese humanoid maker founded in December 2023 that builds the MagicBot Gen1 and the compact MagicBot Z1. It focuses on industrial and service uses.
funding: Angel round of 150 million RMB by December 2024 and a Series B of hundreds of millions of RMB by May 2025, per Robozaps.
